triagePolicy.rule: A pending candidate may be promoted only when the ALC1737 witness itself supports a stable Spanish guide and Cahita form strongly enough for a machine_corrected_unverified transcription. Secondary witnesses may corroborate segmentation or guide identity but may not supply an ALC1737 form.

same_witness_divergence.reason: The phase-II pilot recorded materially divergent readings of the ALC1737 form across independent passes of the same facsimile. These candidates are explicitly excluded from promotion until a stronger same-witness collation resolves the divergence.

guide_identified_form_too_noisy.reason: Recovered primary-witness OCR and/or secondary control support the guide identity, but the exact ALC1737 Cahita form is too noisy or wrapped for promotion.

cross_reference_not_promoted.reason: The guide is identified as a historical cross-reference (`Aullar el adive`), but the primary-witness reading is not promoted from OCR/control evidence alone.

boundary_and_form_ambiguous.reason: The guide is identified as `Atomo`, but the candidate retains `boundaryAssessment=ambiguous`, `reviewStatus=unresolved`, and an insufficiently reliable ALC1737 form.

needs_fresh_same_witness_facsimile_pass.reason: These candidates remain pending in the reconciled page state but are not resolved by the current pilot exclusions or control-evidence record. No sufficiently stable ALC1737 form evidence is recorded in the present phase-II evidence artifacts; a fresh direct same-witness facsimile pass is required before promotion.

nextPassOrder.rationale: No explicit contradictory reading has yet been recorded; a fresh facsimile pass may resolve some candidates without revisiting known divergence cases.
Guide identity is comparatively strong, so work can focus on the ALC1737 Cahita form only.
Requires conservative modeling of a historical cross-reference rather than a normal lexical-form promotion.
Known conflicting same-witness readings make these poor candidates for further automatic promotion without improved visual evidence.

epistemicGuards: This queue changes no transcription and promotes no article.
BUE1890 is secondary control only and must not be copied into ALC1737.
A candidate being structurally classified as article does not imply that its Cahita form is readable enough for promotion.
The 17 pending candidates are not equivalent to 17 missing historical articles because undersegmentation and missed visible starts are tracked separately.
No precision, recall, or F1 value is claimed while the p.145 visible-start census remains non-exhaustive.

provenance.method: Conservative evidence triage of the 17 current p.145 pending_promotion candidates. The queue records blockers and next-pass priority without strengthening any lexical reading.
